tweet.text:
On November 24, we identified unauthorized transfers involving Bullpen accounts opened during our early beta between April and June 2024. Our preliminary count is 18–19 affected accounts, including @blknoiz06’s. Together, they represent less than 0.005% of registered Bullpen accounts.

We’ve taken the affected test service offline. Helping affected users and confirming the full impact is our highest priority. We’ll contact affected users directly with next steps and share updates here every three hours while the investigation is ongoing.
